result.topic_en: Notes on theta functions in several variables (2μ periods): their transformation via Gaussian integrals and Poisson summation, followed by calculations of integer substitution coefficients (α, β, γ, δ, p, q) obtained from continued-fraction-like recursions for a transformation of the theta modulus.
